x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.description: This fix script provides the ability for exisiting customers to opt in for restricting scrum_master, scrum_admin from adding members to group, If the system property 'scrum.disallow_scrum_add_group_member' is set to true - scrum_master, scrum_admin are not allowed to add members to group. If the property is set to false or doesn't exist, scrum_master, scrum_admin will have the ability to add members to group.
x_938076_backup_0_backup_scripts.name: Fix Scrum add/delete member to group ACL
